summary: Verified all five criteria against the live implementation, including all three role-clear examples and a no-match search in the production terminal picker.

acceptanceCriteria.probe: Ran Vitest and inspected extensions/maestro.integration.test.ts and src/maestro/selectAgentModels.ts. First-use clearing Verifier saved Builder A (high) and disabled Verifier without model or thinking. Clearing Simplifier preserved Builder A (high) and Scorer C. Clearing Scorer without a Builder removed its classifier and retained Verifier B (medium). The cancelled replacement model regression also passed; picker cancellation leaves the draft untouched.

Ran the clear-Verifier-then-close integration scenario: Verifier became unset in the draft, the workflow menu returned, and the configuration matched its original bytes. Inspected selectAgentModels: closing returns undefined instead of the draft.

Hosted production selectModel in Pi TuiMainScreen with ProcessTerminal in an Expect PTY. Observed None first, above sample/B and sample/A. Moved down to sample/B, typed z (no matches), and observed only the selected None row between Search and the hint. Down then Enter returned null.

Ran and inspected the all-roles clear/reopen integration scenario: immediately after clearing Builder the draft title identified spec-only mode, Builder was unset, and Verifier B (medium), Simplifier A (low), and Scorer C each had the skipped-without-a-Builder label.

The same integration scenario checked both saved configurations and the reopened menu. With Builder disabled, all three other selections remained intact. Selecting Builder B (high) and confirming preserved those selections, removed skipped labels, and listed all three roles on activation. Inspected the Builder gate in src/workflow/transitions.ts.

notes: npm run check exited successfully (349 tests across 45 files). Its formatter rewrote six Markdown files with existing formatting differences; those edits and temporary probe artifacts were restored or removed. Read-only lint, typecheck, and a separate full Vitest run also succeeded.
